pins.name: +VS
pins.notes: Left leg, flat side facing you. Needs at least 4 V: use VIN (5 V)

pins.name: VOUT
pins.notes: Middle leg. 10 mV per °C, 0 mV at 0 °C. To an ADC pin (prefer ADC1: GPIO 32 to 39)

sources.title: Texas Instruments LM35 datasheet
sources.section: Pin configuration (TO-92) and 10 mV/°C scale factor
